test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven persons, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are staying on different floors of a building with seven floors. There are four floors between the floors of B and D, and B stays on a higher floor than D. There are two floors between the floors of E and A, and A stays on a lower floor than E. C is staying on the ground floor. G and F stay on neighbouring floors. There are two floors between the floors of C and F, and F stays on a higher floor than C.

Who is staying on the top most floor?
solution:
Seven persons, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are staying on different floors of a building with seven floors.

1) C is staying on the ground floor and There are two floors between the floors of C and F, and F stays on a higher floor than C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdb602a436b9bbbd9f2ea86fa090a9fb0a3fd4355d8a13cfc1578f3f9fa54267.png] 

2) There are four floors between the floors of B and D, and B stays on a higher floor than D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63f70ee571a9f4d7ab99bbbf2ddbb96fe6262d7368023ebc4a5a88a7a8656e6e.png] 

3) There are two floors between the floors of E and A, and A stays on a lower floor than E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dbd4935010417abae7cd2114deb1704bf766c2b27bbacc2e123c7266178d55e.png] 

4) G and F stay on neighbouring floors and by combining all the above given statements :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30d68d97029d5e86a8e0453800a2ee67fdabc9afaebd545d5457655b26411b60.png] 

∴ Here, 'B' is staying on top most floor in building.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
